ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a horizontal straight line as the base, and the left end, the middle point of the base, and the right end are on the same straight line. Lines are drawn from the upper vertex respectively to the middle point of the base and to the right end, forming left and right two triangles. The left base angle of the small triangle on the left is labeled 50°, and the angle at the middle point of the base adjacent to the left-side base is labeled 70°; on the right side of the same point, the left base angle of the right triangle is labeled ∠2. The right base angle of the large triangle on the right is labeled 21°, and the angle at the upper vertex related to the right triangle is labeled ∠3. Reasoning: At the middle point of the base, the 70° angle and ∠2 are adjacent on the same straight line, forming a set of linear angles, so ∠2 = 180° - 70° = 110°. In the triangle on the right, the three interior angles are respectively ∠2, 21°, and ∠3, therefore ∠3 = 180° - 110° - 21° = 49°.
